Decadal surfaces and contours supply manually selected route points.
Species suitability labels guide separate herring and mackerel trajectory fits.
Forecast temperature series supply adjacent-year rates.
Five-state histories supply empirical transition counts.
The one-step matrix and initial state supply future rate probabilities.
Future rate scenarios are claimed to update temperature fields for exit scanning.
Species-suitable cells supply the geographic side of the exit event.
The Scrabster operating radius bounds the exit-event search.
Twelve species-decade route points supply the one-port objective.
Paired species points supply each decadal port objective.
Single-port distances are compared with the old-vessel range.
Decadal port distances are compared with the old-vessel range.
Forecast route points are classified against Icelandic and Norwegian boundary samples.
Fitted routes supply the qualitative external-map and BP validation inputs.
Best and worst exit years bound the reported twenty-year BP comparison.
Territorial classifications supply the reported back and cross error-rate claims.
